name: Scheme for Reimbursement of Testing and Certification Charges for Start-ups and Telecom MSEs
benefit:
> **Financial Assistance:**

1. The reimbursement of testing and certification charges will be provided as follows:

  - Start-Ups: Up to 75% of testing and certification charges
  - Micro Enterprises: Up to 60% of testing and certification charges
  - Small Enterprises: Up to 50% of testing and certification charges

1. The reimbursement is applicable for testing conducted at:

  - Telecommunicat
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a Start-up registered with the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Government of India. 1. The applicant should be a Micro or Small Enterprise registered under the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME). 1. The applicant should be incorporated within Indian territory. 1. The applicant’s annual revenue should not exceed ₹5,00,00,000/- in any financial year since incorporation. 1. The applicant (Start-up) should not have raised funds exceeding ₹10,00,00,000/-.
